name: @nexus/mcp-composio-admin
description: MCP server that exposes Composio actions to Claude Code sessions, scoped strictly to Admin-scope connected accounts (business_slug='_admin' in connected_accounts). Hard-isolation companion to PR #152's rube-mcp install — replaces it on the shared claude-gateway so the platform-copilot can never accidentally invoke an action against a Shared or per-business token.
